facts: Minimum recommended CPU: modern 8+ cores with good single-core performance.
Locally attached NVMe SSD recommended; RAID 0 can improve performance.
Capacity formula: 2 x current chain size + snapshot size +20% buffer.
Base node requires Ethereum L1 execution and beacon endpoints; self-hosted L1 must be synced first.

reasonNoBenchmark: No passwordless sudo available and current user lacks raw-disk access; no privileged-container workaround or device permission change attempted.
interpretation: The earlier report uncertainty about 32/64 GB is resolved: these figures are RAM. HDD-only Base-node suitability remains unsupported and unbenchmarked, not a measured impossibility. Capacity alone does not establish live-node I/O performance.
unchangedConstraints: No full-chain sync or node deployment
No formatting, RAID reconfiguration or purchase
